title: Agent profile front matter
description: The YAML front matter of profiles/<id>.md. scripts/check-profiles.sh enforces it with a small stdlib validator (type, enum, pattern, required, items, minItems, uniqueItems, minLength, additionalProperties, patternProperties, default). A field declares; it does not enforce. The body layout and caps are under x-body.

id.description: <rank>-<role>. Equals the file name; the prefix equals rank.

version.description: A quoted dotted number. Must rise when an authority field changes.

section.description: The staff lane or echelon the profile belongs to (doctrine/units.md). There is no S5.

rank.description: A permission tier (doctrine/units.md). Our extension, not army doctrine.

model.description: Default model tier or id, or auto.

skills.description: Skill names only; the skills themselves stay in argus-config.

tools.description: Allowed and denied tools. Both lists are required so a change to either is visible.

inputs.description: What the profile receives. The original issue text always travels verbatim, listed or not.

escalates_to.description: Where an owner question goes: a profile id, or owner.

runtime.description: Reserved (D7). Defaults to claude; only claude is accepted while the fields are Claude-shaped.

x-authority.description: A change to any of these (compared with the base, defaults filled in) needs a higher version. The owner's approval is a review step the check cannot see.

x-body.description: Body layout (D3): these sections in this order, then an optional Voice, then an optional Learned. Learned is capped (D8).
